# The Journal of Healthcare Contracting

> > The Journal of Healthcare Contracting (JHC) is a leading trade publication covering healthcare supply chain management, GPO contracting, medical device procurement, and hospital purchasing strategies.

JHC provides in-depth analysis of healthcare contracting trends, supply chain best practices, executive profiles, and industry news for hospital materials managers, IDN purchasing leaders, and healthcare suppliers. The publication features insights from major GPOs like Novation, health systems like SSM Health Care, and regulatory perspectives from organizations including JCAHO.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare contracting
- Supply chain management
- Group purchasing organizations (GPOs)
- Medical devices and equipment
- Patient safety
- Hospital purchasing
- Revenue cycle management
- IDN (Integrated Delivery Networks)
- Physician preference items
- Healthcare partnerships
- Supply chain contracting
- Executive leadership
- Healthcare compliance
- Sustainability in healthcare
- Healthcare margins

## Supply Chain Strategy & Management

- [Revenue's Side of the Story](https://www.jhconline.com/revenues-side-of-the-story.html): SSM Health Care's revenue cycle integration with supply chain contracting
- [IDNs Look to LLCs As an Alternative](https://www.jhconline.com/idns-look-to-llcs-as-an-alternative.html): AtlantiCare's Perry Miller on LLC purchasing model for IDN networks
- [Odd Man Out](https://www.jhconline.com/odd-man-out.html): Physician preference items and vendor relationships compliance challenges
- [Pain Management](https://www.jhconline.com/pain-management.html): Medical Action Industries' lean manufacturing and price management strategies
- [Being Green](https://www.jhconline.com/being-green.html): Legacy Health System's Tom Badrick on Portland sustainability programs

## Patient Safety & Clinical Quality

- [Healthcare's Dirty Secret](https://www.jhconline.com/healthcares-dirty-secret.html): Betsy McCaughey on healthcare-acquired infections and mandatory reporting
- [The Right Prescription](https://www.jhconline.com/the-right-prescription.html): Pharmacy director Larry McComber on medication safety and unit-dose systems

## Industry News & Updates

- [Contracting News May/June 2006](https://www.jhconline.com/contracting-news-mayjune-2005-2.html): Premier Inc. spine implant contracts with Medtronic, EBI, Aesculap
- [Contracting News April 2010](https://www.jhconline.com/contracting-news-april-2010.html): VHA supplier awards, executive appointments, and health reform updates
- [Contracting News July/August 2008](https://www.jhconline.com/contracting-news-julyaugust-2008.html): Healthcare appointments, Banner Health expansion, hospital partnerships
- [Contracting News February 2010](https://www.jhconline.com/contracting-news-february-2010.html): Broadlane CEO Patrick Ryan appointment and Premier Alliance updates

## Leadership & Professional Development

- [Fired Up on Ice](https://www.jhconline.com/fired-up-on-ice.html): Mike Langlois career profile: St. John Hospital supply chain leadership
- [Silence Speaks Volumes](https://www.jhconline.com/silence-speaks-volumes.html): Brian Sullivan on active listening and silence in sales communication
- [Making the most of Q&A sessions](https://www.jhconline.com/making-the-most-of-qa-sessions.html): Marjorie Brody on presentation skills and handling audience questions

## Editorial Commentary
